description: Email queue worker: claim the oldest message, send it, retry with backoff or fail permanently.
precondition: Queued email rows with attempts below the maximum; provider reachable.

preconditions: No email in the queue.
Defaults: MaxAttempts 8, RetryDelaySeconds 60, ProcessingLeaseSeconds 120.
cases.return: NoWork, AttemptCount 0. The provider is not called.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 0, ToAddress an@example.vn.
The provider accepts the message and returns id "re_123".
cases.log: The message is claimed: status Processing, AttemptCount 1, a lease token, lease expiry 2026-11-18T03:02:00Z. Then it is marked Sent with provider id re_123 and sent time 03:00Z. An information line is logged.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real email provider; the Sent id comes from the provider.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 0.
The provider throws a timeout error.
cases.log: The message returns to Queued with NextAttemptAt 03:01:00Z (60 s x 1), the error "TimeoutException: ..." stored and the failure time recorded. A warning is logged.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider timeout to observe retry scheduling.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 2 before the claim (so 3 after it).
The provider throws an error.
cases.log: NextAttemptAt is 03:04:00Z: the delay doubles with each attempt (60 s x 4 on attempt 3).
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider error to observe the doubled backoff.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 6 before the claim (7 after it); MaxAttempts 8.
The provider throws an error.
cases.log: NextAttemptAt is 04:04:00Z (60 s x 64 = 3840 s). One attempt below the maximum still retries.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider error to observe the backoff near the attempt limit.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 7 before the claim (8 after it); MaxAttempts 8.
The provider throws an error.
cases.log: The message is marked Failed with the error text and no NextAttemptAt. An error line is logged.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider error to observe permanent failure at the limit.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 0.
The provider refuses the message for good (a permanent failure).
cases.return: PermanentlyFailed, AttemptCount 1: no retry is scheduled although attempts remain.
cases.log: The message is marked Failed on its first attempt; an error line is logged.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real permanent provider refusal.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, AttemptCount 11 before the claim; MaxAttempts configured as 20.
The provider throws an error.
cases.log: The delay stops doubling at 1024 times the base: NextAttemptAt is 03:00Z + 61440 s (60 s x 1024).
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider error to observe the capped backoff.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, ToAddress demo@demo.invalid; the domain demo.invalid is in Email:UndeliverableDomains.
cases.return: PermanentlyFailed, AttemptCount 1. The provider is not called.
cases.log: The message is marked Failed at once with the error "Not sent: the recipient's domain never receives mail (Email:UndeliverableDomains)." and no retry; an information line is logged.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, ToAddress demo@DEMO.invalid. (upper case, trailing dot); the blocked domain is demo.invalid.
cases.return: PermanentlyFailed: the domain match ignores case and a trailing dot.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, ToAddress "no-at-sign" (no @).
The undeliverable list is not empty.
cases.return: Sent: an address without @ is not treated as undeliverable and is handed to the provider.
cases.log: N/A
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider; an address without @ is handed to it.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, The provider call is slower than SendAttemptTimeoutSeconds (60 s); the worker was not asked to stop.
cases.return: RetryScheduled, AttemptCount 1: the per-attempt timeout is counted as a failed attempt.
cases.log: The message returns to Queued with NextAttemptAt 03:01:00Z and an error naming the cancellation.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real slow provider to observe the per-attempt timeout.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, The host is shutting down while the provider call is running.
cases.inputs: Cancellation token already cancelled by the host.
cases.exception: OperationCanceledException is rethrown to the worker.
cases.log: The message is left Processing with its lease, so the attempt can be recovered later; nothing is marked failed or sent.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real store honoring host cancellation mid-claim.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, The provider accepts the message, but the lease row no longer belongs to this worker (another worker reclaimed it).
cases.log: Marking Sent updates 0 rows; a warning about the lost lease is logged.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider accept plus a lost processing lease.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, The provider throws, and the lease is no longer owned by this worker.
cases.log: Marking the attempt failed updates 0 rows; a warning is logged.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider failure plus a lost processing lease.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, Undeliverable recipient domain, and the lease is no longer owned by this worker.
cases.log: N/A

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, The provider accepts the message, then the database fails while saving the Sent state.
cases.exception: The database error escapes to the worker; it is not recorded as a send failure because the provider may already have delivered the message.
cases.log: N/A
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider accept plus a real store failure on finalize.

preconditions: A Queued email is due: NextAttemptAt in the past, The provider throws an error whose message is 5000 characters long.
cases.log: The stored error text is cut to 2000 characters.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider error text to verify truncation.

preconditions: A Queued email with AttemptCount 8 (the maximum) is still waiting.
No other due email.
cases.log: Before the claim, rows that reached MaxAttempts are marked Failed; nothing is sent.

preconditions: Two Queued emails: one due 02:50Z, another due 02:55Z; one more with NextAttemptAt 04:00Z (not due).
cases.return: Sent, AttemptCount 1 for the oldest due email only.
cases.log: Only the 02:50Z email is claimed and sent; the other two are untouched.
cases.note: BR-38 · BR-76 · Pending: needs a real provider to send the oldest due email.

preconditions: The only Queued email has NextAttemptAt 03:01Z (in the future).
cases.log: N/A
